headline: Water gets more expensive in Bucharest. How much the price per cubic meter will reach
summary: The water tariff in Bucharest will rise by 0.85 lei per cubic metre after an additional act was approved to the concession contract between the Capital City Hall and Apa Nova. The change applies to the city's water service.
why: Apa Nova operates Bucharest's water concession, so tariff changes under the contract affect its revenues and regulated utility pricing in Romania's capital.
